content.before: Check your web workspace, source-install setup, usable speech models and a safe sample draft first. Prepare whatever is missing before involving real business material.
content.after: Choose store installation or a separate source build, then check your own workspace, voice-model readiness if needed and a safe synthetic draft. Do not use real business material for the first check.

content.before: 2. Check Mac/Xcode/XcodeGen, your signing, iOS 18+ and a trusted HTTPS workspace.
content.after: 2. The verified US store edition 0.1.0 installs without a Mac or self-signing. Source developers separately need Mac/Xcode/XcodeGen and their own signing. Use iOS 18+ and your own trusted HTTPS workspace.

content.before: 3. Confirm compatible models are downloaded and usable, then arrange mic permission and recording consent where needed.
content.after: 3. If you choose native voice input, prepare the optional speech-model download, microphone permission and recording consent. Viewing the synthetic web preview does not download the Yihu speech model or record audio.
